messages:
maya: Quick sync — planning to publish python-sdk 2.0.0 and js-sdk 1.4.0 tomorrow 2026-04-02 14:00 PT. Main points: deprecate legacy sync API, add batching improvements, and bump default timeouts. Can we do a short canary (5% traffic) then gradual rollout?
kevin: Works for infra. What is the change window you want? we usually do 14:00-15:00 PT weekdays for SDKs.
sasha: FYI, docs patch needs a migration guide and a deprecation banner on the docs site. I can prepare it today.
maya: Change window 14:00-15:00 PT is fine. plan: 14:00 canary for 1hr -> 50% at 14:15 -> full at 14:45 if no issues. rollback plan if errors > 3% or latency regression > 200ms.
ana: @maya small nit: you mean @ana :)
ana: (ignore)
ana: oh right name mixup — sorry
ana: --
ana: Actually I'll replace with correct messages below
ana: fixed: @ana :)
nana: ok continuing
ana: ops checklist: create canary routing policy, pin model to redwood/opt-3b:2026-03-28 for canary, and set rate limits for SDK endpoints.
ana: also we should pin python example in quickstart to v2.0.0 in the repo.
ana: for npm we need to update peerDependencies and explain break in CHANGELOG.
li: Publishing notes — PyPI can't un-publish a version, so if we need to revert we should immediately publish 2.0.1 with a fix and yanking via release notes. npm can unpublish within 72h but prefer deprecate tag.
li: Add commands: 
```
# python build + upload
python -m build
twine upload dist/*

# npm
npm version 1.4.0
npm publish --access public
npm deprecate @redwood/js-sdk@<1.4.0 "Deprecated, upgrade to >=1.4.0"
```
kevin: For rollout automation: deploy-bot can apply traffic weights. @deploy-bot can you queue the canary and hold for 1h?
deploy-bot: scheduled canary for channel devex on 1763584800; 5% traffic -> will auto-bump to 50% at +15m and to 100% at +45m unless a rollback trigger fires.
kevin: Perfect. We'll monitor SLO dashboard and have on-call paged on regression.
jordan: Quick ask — do we need to pin versions in example repos? I can open a tiny PR to pin requirements.txt and package.json.
maya: Yes please. Pin python to ">=2.0.0,<3.0.0" and JS peerDependency to "^1.4.0". Also add a deprecation note for legacy sync API and link migration guide.
sasha: Docs will include code snippets and annotated diff. I'll post PR link when ready.
li: Also update changelog with migration steps + snippet showing converting sync calls to async batched calls. Small snippet: 
```python
# old sync
client.sync_call(...)

# new async batch
async with Client() as c:
    await c.batch_call([...])
```
maya: Rollback criteria again: >3% error rate, >200ms 95p latency regression, or user-reported major break in first 30m. If rollback: for npm we deprecate 1.4.0 and push 1.4.1. For PyPI publish 2.0.1 and patch release — we can't remove 2.0.0.
kevin: On infra side we'll also pin traffic to dedicated instances if needed to reduce variance.
nana: Who will write the release notes?
maya: sasha + li will draft. I'll review and send out release announcement to #announcements once we hit full.
sasha: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/472 (WIP) — migration guide + banner.
jordan: I'll open the example repo PRs now. ETA 2 hours.
kevin: I'll watch the deploy and SLOs. paging policy set.
maya: Thanks all. If nothing else we ship tomorrow 14:00 PT. :rocket:
